observation.title: Opening-range midpoint reclaim observation
source_references: prospective engineering example; no performance outcome used
observation.observed_behavior: After an early decline inside the opening range, a high-volume reclaim of the fixed midpoint may precede a return toward the fixed range high.

hypothesis.title: Opening-range midpoint reclaim continuation
hypothesis.market_assumption: The first five regular-session minutes establish a short-lived reference range followed by temporary two-sided price discovery.
hypothesis.mechanism: A high-volume reclaim of the fixed opening-range midpoint after a close below it may reflect failed early selling and renewed demand.
hypothesis.expected_edge: Positive net expectancy after frozen costs relative to zero, subject to minimum evidence and concentration rules.
known_risks: synthetic example provides no empirical evidence
hypothesis.expected_holding_period: zero to thirty complete one-minute bars
hypothesis.expected_market_regime: unspecified; all eligible regimes reported without filtering

reasons: complete one-minute inputs already fit the shared proposal pipeline
small vertical slice directly falsifies lifecycle integration

specification.decision_window: 09:36 through 10:30 America/New_York using complete left-labeled one-minute bars
specification.signal_rule: Previous completed close is at or below the midpoint of the fixed 09:30-09:34 range; current completed bar closes strictly above that midpoint and below the range high, closes above its open, and volume is at least 1.5 times the median volume of the five opening-range bars.
specification.entry_rule: Existing shared proposal pipeline at the exact next one-minute bar open with zero permitted delay.
specification.missing_data_rule: Any absent required minute makes the evaluation unavailable; no forward fill or interpolation.
specification.integrity_rule: Duplicate, nonchronological, naive, nonfinite, nonpositive-price, negative-volume, mixed-symbol, mixed-session, or malformed-OHLC input fails closed.
